d:
Bharat aur izrail ke bich raksha sahyog lagatar majbut huaa hai, lekin pashchim eshiya men izrail ki sainy karravaee bharat ke kshetriy aur aarthik hiton ke lie chunauti ban rahi hai. stenli joni ke is vishleshan men samjhie ki bharat ke lie izrail ke sath rannitik sanbandhon aur philistin niti ke bich santulan banana kyon jaruri hai.
Thank you for watching our video!
